daily_mean_crps.within_day_reduction: CRPS of the scenario-wise hourly mean

conventions.delta: shuffled minus original; positive score delta favors original pairing
conventions.increments: signed capacity_fraction differences, per lead CRPS then within-day mean; no clipping
conventions.repeats: five permutations are Monte Carlo controls, not new trainings or weather data
conventions.aggregation: average five permutations within each trained model first; then describe three training seeds
conventions.tolerance: engineering invariance checks only, not statistical significance
conventions.permutation: CPU Generator, randperm(M) in canonical day/hour order; indices reused across all nine panels
